biocs.name: Unusual DB process spawning a shell
biocs.description: Detects when a database process such as mysqld spawns a shell process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'mysqld' and action_process_image_name = '/tmp/scratch/db_shell'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'mysqld'
